3.name: Episode 64
3.overview: Following the bloody wedding, the Albora mansion is plunged into deep mourning. Returning to Mardin unaware of what has happened, Alya is devastated by one painful revelation after another and finds Cihan a changed man. The decision he makes will alter not only their lives, but also Cihan Deniz's fate. As Sadakat faces her deepest grief and guilt, Nare's choices following her devastating loss push the Albora family toward a new danger. Meanwhile, developments involving Demir draw Zerrin into an unexpected reckoning. After losing both sons, Ecmel turns his grief into rage and devises a dangerous plan that could change everything. Months later, Alya tries to build a new life with her son in Budapest, believing she has left the past behind, until an unexpected encounter brings unfinished business and unspoken words back to the surface. Meanwhile, Hasan carries a devastating secret that, once revealed, will overturn everything the family believes to be true.

3.name: Episode 65
3.overview: Cihan's decision to bring Cihan Deniz to Mardin reignites the war between him and Alya. Following them, to reunite with her son, Alya is forced to confront Cihan and the feelings they have never managed to silence. But Ecmel's unexpected move puts Alya before a dangerous choice that could destroy both her and Cihan. Meanwhile, Zerrin's desire to reunite with her daughter pushes the Albora and Baybars families toward an irreversible conflict, while Nare's attempt to suppress her grief brings the mansion's hidden wounds to the surface. As Sadakat's long-held secret comes closer to being exposed, the mysterious Kartal arrives in Midyat with an unknown purpose. At the same time, Ateş's release from prison signals a new reckoning that could change every balance. With the Albora family's deepest secret finally on the verge of being revealed, an unexpected step by Alya forces her to confront her own conscience.

3.name: Episode 66
3.overview: Following Alya's decision, the deep rift between her and Cihan becomes increasingly difficult to repair. Cihan's determination to never give up on his son leaves Alya with no choice but to take measures she never expected. Meanwhile, Kaya is shaken when he sees Zerrin with another man, bringing their unresolved past back to the surface, while İpek finds herself facing an unexpected confrontation. Alya's unexpected alliance with Nare sets her on a path toward an outcome she could not have foreseen, while a new figure quietly prepares to make a move against the Albora family.

3.name: Episode 67
3.overview: As Alya prepares to leave Midyat with Cihan Deniz, an unexpected incident at the airport turns all her plans upside down. Suddenly facing a serious accusation, Alya now fears not only losing her freedom but also being separated from her son. Cihan sets out to prove her innocence, but every step brings a new obstacle. Meanwhile, an unexpected encounter forces Kartal to confront feelings he thought he had left behind, while a letter from the Albora family's past begins to uncover a long-hidden secret. As Hasan tries to keep the truth buried, the arrival of someone who could expose it pushes Sadakat toward an unexpected reckoning. With Alya increasingly cornered, her desperate attempts to protect her son lead Cihan to make a decision he cannot accept, deepening the war between them.

3.name: Episode 68
3.overview: Alya's freedom does not end her war with Cihan but pushes their conflict to a breaking point. Facing the possibility of being separated from her son, Alya refuses to back down, while Cihan sets his own rules to avoid losing her and Cihan Deniz. Their love gives way to a fierce confrontation that neither can easily walk away from. Meanwhile, the danger surrounding the Albora family continues to grow. As Cihan fights those threatening his family, he realizes that his enemies are joining forces. Kartal's quiet moves and Ateş's new alliances signal an impending war. Nare's emotional turmoil creates new wounds within the family, while tensions between Kaya and Zerrin become increasingly dangerous. As everyone is drawn into their own battles, Alya makes an unexpected decision that will turn her relationship with Cihan upside down.

3.name: Episode 69
3.overview: The news of Alya's marriage with Enver reaches Cihan, intensifying the turmoil within him. Meanwhile, Alya's new arrangement to reunite with her son takes the conflict between them in an entirely new direction. Just as Nare struggles to put her life back together, a devastating betrayal by someone close to her forces her to confront the feelings she has been trying to escape. Unexpectedly, Ateş becomes the one to offer her a helping hand. Meanwhile, Kartal learns a shocking truth about Alya, bringing the weight of his long-hidden past back to the surface. His next moves will send shockwaves through Albora. As Alya discovers an unexpected truth and Cihan, caught in a major conspiracy, finds himself on the verge of a new deal, revelations in two different places trigger a turning point that will change everyone's fate.

3.name: Episode 70
3.overview: Alya realizes she can no longer hide her feelings and makes a decision, while Cihan has something to confess as well. When they meet in the courtyard that night, both know truths they cannot bring themselves to say aloud. Meanwhile, Sadakat, who has always believed no secret in these lands could escape her, is about to discover a truth she never saw coming. Nare is forced to confront her past, from photographs exposing her family's secrets to a grave she has avoided for years, where an unexpected person awaits her. Fidan holds leverage powerful enough to silence even Sadakat, but when Kaya's anger enters the equation, the family faces a terrible ordeal. As Alya loses the custody battle, a new revelation from Ecmel threatens to overturn everything. Desperate to keep her son, Alya is willing to do whatever it takes to stop Ecmel, bringing her into yet another dangerous confrontation with Cihan.

3.name: Episode 71
3.overview: Alya's fear of being unable to protect her son brings her unbreakable bond with Cihan to the surface once again. Yet hidden truths and promises make it increasingly difficult for them to find their way back to each other. As Cihan pursues Ecmel to clear Alya's name and protect Cihan Deniz, he discovers that his uncle is not the only obstacle standing in his way. Meanwhile, a secret from the past shakes Sadakat, forcing her into an inner struggle to keep her family together. The dinner arranged for Berfin at the mansion makes Alya and Cihan confront the pain of separation in an unexpected way, while Cihan Deniz's efforts to keep his parents together bring their suppressed feelings to the surface. As Alya's hope of starting a new life with her son grows, Cihan struggles between his desire to protect her and his fear of losing her. The prospect of freedom brings them both to the brink of an even greater test.

overview: آلیا آلبورا همراه جسد شوهرش و پسر پنج ساله‌اش از کانادا به ماردین می‌آید تا به وصیت شوهرش عمل کند. با این حال این آمدن، رفتنی ندارد و راه خروجی از آلبورا وجود ندارد. جهان آلبورا که رئيس طایفه آلبوراست، با این که نسبت به ناراحتی آلیا بی‌توجهی نمی‌کند ولی اجازه نمی‌دهد فرزندش را بردارد و از آنجا برود. آلیا آلبورا که با تاریکی گذشته، رازهای پنهان و حقیقت منطقه روبرو می شود، به یکباره چشم باز می‌کند و خود را درون کشمکش بزرگی با خانواده شوهرش می بیند…

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A woman and her son arrive in her late husband's homeland with his corpse, determined to give him a proper burial. But his powerful family soon traps her in a web of secrets and control, making her escape impossible.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Cihan and Alya return to the mansion determined to protect their love despite all obstacles and the heavy price it may bring. Alya's refusal to go to Canada is seen by Sadakat as the beginning of disaster.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Cihan and Alya's reunion in Budapest takes an unexpected turn when Cihan insists on taking Deniz back to Mardin for his safety. As the only one who can carry on Ecmel's lineage, Deniz becomes the center of a new and dangerous family struggle, forcing Alya to fight to protect her son.

title: Far Away
